classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design, rank, and submit a protein binder for the 137-residue target sequence directed toward hotspot residues Q25/A35/F36/G39/Y40/V72/Y73/Y76/Y128/L132, contacting ≥5 of those residues, then return Reason: and Answer: for the top candidate.
assumptions: Target sequence is 137 residues; binder length of 70 residues is a reasonable initial estimate for interface coverage.
Hotspot residues map to 1-indexed FASTA positions: Q25, A35, F36, G39, Y40, V72, Y73, Y76, Y128, L132 — all verified against the provided sequence.
At least 5 of 10 specified hotspot residues will be contacted in the top design (≥50% contact goal is the acceptance threshold).
No experimental structure available; target will be folded from sequence via Protenix-v2 before binder design.
PXDesign pipeline mode (AF2-IG + ProteinMPNN) is validated and available locally.
In-silico metrics (pLDDT, iPTM, PTM, interface contacts, protein QC) are used as acceptance criteria in the absence of experimental validation.
8 samples with top-k=4 provides sufficient diversity for meaningful ranking in a single round.
Final response will include Reason: (design rationale, hotspot contact summary, top metric scores) and Answer: (top binder amino-acid sequence).
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: target_sequence_binder_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Fold a target sequence, generate hotspot-directed binders with PXDesign pipeline mode, analyze, QC, and rank candidates.

candidates.justification: Top ranked binder candidate from rank_designs.

inputs.reasoning: Selected the top ranked binder after target folding, hotspot-directed binder design, structure analysis, QC, and ranking.

success_criteria.hotspot_contacts: Top binder contacts ≥5 of 10 specified hotspot residues at ≤5 Å interface distance
success_criteria.ranking: All candidates ranked by composite score; top-1 explicitly submitted via submit_candidate
success_criteria.output_fields: Final response includes Reason: (design rationale, hotspot contact count, key metric scores) and Answer: (top binder amino-acid sequence)
